mapper.select: INSERT INTO support_program ( external_id, title, organization, region, target, application_start, application_end, support_amount, original_url, raw_content ) VALUES ( #{externalId}, #{title}, #{organization}, #{region}, #{target}, #{applicationStart}, #{applicationEnd}, #{supportAmount}, #{originalUrl}, #{rawContent} ) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, organization = EXCLUDED.organization, target = EXCLUDED.target, application_start = EXCLUDED.application_start, application_end = EXCLUDED.application_end, original_url = EXCLUDED.original_url, raw_content = EXCLUDED.raw_content RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted

SELECT id, external_id, title, organization, region, target, application_start, application_end, support_amount, original_url, raw_content, created_at, updated_at FROM support_program WHERE external_id = #{externalId}
